components.name: Navigation Bar
components.summary: A title in the middle with glass buttons at its ends, as on iOS 26: Back, and a button at the other end when Action names one. Both report taps. No bar is drawn behind them; Tint and Back Title are kept for documents that set them and change nothing.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A switch: tap to turn it on or off. The knob slides and the track fills with the tint.

components.name: List Row
components.summary: A table row: a title, with an optional symbol, subtitle and detail, and a chevron, checkmark or switch at the end. It highlights while pressed and reports taps.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.summary: A row of choices, one selected. Give it a comma-separated list; it makes a segment for each.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: Drag to choose a value between Minimum and Maximum, 0 to 1 unless you say otherwise. It stretches to whatever width you give it.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Minus and plus buttons that count down and up by Step, from Value, between Minimum and Maximum.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A button that dims while pressed and reports taps: Filled, Tinted, Gray or Plain. A large corner radius makes it a capsule.

components.name: Tab Bar
components.summary: Tabs with a symbol and a title each; tapping one selects it. Give it comma-separated titles and symbol names. It is a capsule of glass as wide as its tabs, floating above the bottom of the screen, as on iOS 26; with Floating off it is a flat bar from edge to edge.
